name: proxy-manager
title: Proxy Manager
description: Control Proxy Manager without leaving Raycast: routing on/off, targets, and per-app rules.
author: chaim-chv

commands.name: index
commands.title: Proxy Manager
commands.subtitle: Routing status & targets
commands.description: See the routing state, the app and the site in front of you, and manage the target list.

commands.name: toggle-routing
commands.title: Toggle Routing
commands.subtitle: Turn the tunnel on or off
commands.description: Flips routing and reports the result in a HUD. Built for a hotkey.

commands.name: add-target
commands.title: Add Target
commands.description: Route a host or wildcard through the tunnel. Prefills the tab you are on.

commands.name: explain-host
commands.title: Explain Host Routing
commands.description: Show why a host goes through the tunnel or direct — the tab you are on, or one you name.

commands.name: app-routing
commands.title: App Routing
commands.description: Per-app rules: send an app through the tunnel, its targets, or direct. Starts with the app you are in.

preferences.name: appPath
preferences.title: Proxy Manager App
preferences.description: The app to launch when Proxy Manager is not running.

preferences.name: supportDirectory
preferences.title: Support Folder
preferences.description: Folder that holds control.sock and control.token. Only change it if you moved Proxy Manager's data.
